# Myth

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Myth`](gmeow-Myth.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Myth>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)

A socially-sustained narrative whose currency is independent of its truth-value — a founding myth, an urban legend, a propaganda narrative, or a debunked claim that persists. GMEOW asserts no truth verdict on a myth ([Principle 1](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-1)); in-myth claims are scoped [`accordingTo`](../properties/gmeow-accordingTo.md) an associated [`gmeow:NarrativeReferenceFrame`](gmeow-NarrativeReferenceFrame.md). A myth is the abstract narrative (WEMI [`Work`](gmeow-Work.md) level); concrete tellings are linked via [`gmeow:hasMythTelling`](../properties/gmeow-hasMythTelling.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:SocialObject`](gmeow-SocialObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Myth`](gmeow-Myth.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:SocialObject`](gmeow-SocialObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
